sourceClarifications: 25.1 and 25.57: Printed images specify a lightning duration of 40 microseconds. Extracted text incorrectly shows milliseconds.
25.15: Silver resistivity is 1.47e-8 ohm metres in the visual material table.
25.24: Printed prompt specifies positive 4.0 degrees Celsius, despite winter wording.
25.31: V_ab is negative after reversing the 16 V source, with terminal a now adjacent to the negative terminal. Current direction and node potentials were independently solved.
25.61: Printed prompt gives 8.40 V at 1.50 A discharge and 10.20 V at 3.50 A charge, yielding r=0.360 ohms and emf=8.94 V.
25.65: Annual operating costs use an explicitly stated 365-day year.
25.67: Printed appendix uses microohms and microvolts per metre, matching the printed radius of 1.10 cm. Text extraction misidentifies the micro symbol.
25.79: The best multiple-choice description is distinguished from quantitative reversibility; the data have substantial hysteresis.
25.6: Gold material valuation uses a dated primary quotation and NIST unit conversion, with manufacturing excluded.

renderEvidence.scope: The final chapter build includes both 25.73 plots and the corrected neA unit C/m. Transition and Wiki checks were run before that unit-only correction, with unchanged layouts and Wiki content.
